privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.intro: This policy explains how Envision Ad (the “Platform”), available at envision-ad.ca, collects, uses, shares and protects personal information, and the rights you have over it. It is written to meet Quebec’s Act respecting the protection of personal information in the private sector. It applies alongside our <link>Terms of Service</link>.

who.title: 1. Who we are
who.p1: The Platform is operated by [TO CONFIRM: legal entity name], whose registered office is at [TO CONFIRM: registered address] (“Visual Impact”, “we”, “us” or “our”).
who.p2: The Platform is for businesses. The personal information we handle is mostly about the people who use it on their organization’s behalf: owners, employees and other representatives of advertisers and media owners. This policy also covers visitors to our public pages.

officer.title: 2. Person in charge of protecting personal information
officer.p1: The person in charge of protecting personal information at Visual Impact is [TO CONFIRM: name and title]. You can reach them at [TO CONFIRM: privacy contact email] for any question, request or complaint about this policy or your personal information.

collect.title: 3. What we collect
collect.listIntro: We collect only what we need to run the Platform:

items.account: Account information: first and last name, email address, username, profile picture, an optional bio, your preferred language, and your login, which our authentication provider manages.
items.organization: Organization information: your organization’s name, address, size, its role as advertiser or media owner, its members, and the email addresses of people invited to join it.
items.billing: Billing information: the subscriptions your organization holds, the amounts, dates and status of its payments, and the identifiers Stripe gives them. Your card details go directly to Stripe and never reach our servers.
items.payouts: Payout information for media owners: Stripe collects the identity, bank and tax information it needs to verify your account and pay you. We receive only your Stripe account identifier and whether your account is verified and able to receive payouts.
items.content: Content you add: ads (images and videos), screen descriptions, locations and photos, and proof-of-display links. If an ad or photo shows a person, it contains personal information about them.
items.technical: Technical information: the cookies listed in section 9, and the technical data, such as your IP address, that our servers record when you use the Platform.

collect.p1: We do not use any technology to identify, locate or profile you, and the Platform has no advertising or analytics trackers.

how.title: 4. How we collect it
how.p1: We collect personal information from you directly, when you or a member of your organization fill in the Platform; from your organization, when an administrator creates your account or a member invites you; from Auth0 and Stripe, as described above; and automatically, through cookies and server logs.

purposes.title: 5. Why we use it

items.accounts: create and secure accounts, and verify organizations;
items.service: run the Platform: list screens, run subscriptions, send ads to media owners and show proof of display to advertisers;
items.payments: bill advertisers, pay media owners and keep accounting records;
items.emails: send service emails, such as invitations, notices about new campaigns and creative changes, and monthly proof-of-display reminders, in your preferred language;
items.security: protect the Platform, detect and prevent fraud and abuse, and fix problems;
items.legal: meet our legal obligations and enforce our Terms of Service.

purposes.p1: We use personal information only for these purposes, or for another purpose with your consent or where the law allows it. We do not sell personal information, and we do not send marketing emails [TO CONFIRM: whether any marketing emails will be sent].

sharing.title: 6. Who we share it with
sharing.p1: Within the Platform: members of your organization can see each other and your organization’s data. Media owners whose screens are in a subscription receive the advertiser’s organization name, campaign and ads. Advertisers see the screens they subscribe to and the proof-of-display links media owners provide. Screen listings are public.
sharing.listIntro: Service providers that process personal information for us:

items.stripe: Stripe: card payments, and verification and payouts for media owners;
items.cloudinary: Cloudinary: storage and delivery of ads;
items.aws: Amazon Web Services: hosting of the Platform and its database;
items.email: [TO CONFIRM: email provider]: delivery of service emails;
items.maps: OpenStreetMap and CARTO: address search and maps. When you search for an address or view a map, your browser sends the search terms and your IP address directly to them.

sharing.p2: We give each provider only the information it needs, and we require it by contract to protect it [TO CONFIRM: written agreements in place with each provider]. We may also disclose personal information when the law requires it, or to a buyer or successor if our business is sold or reorganized, under the conditions the law sets.

outsideQuebec.title: 7. Storage outside Quebec
outsideQuebec.p1: Our database is hosted by Amazon Web Services in Canada (Montréal region). Some providers, including Auth0, Stripe and Cloudinary, may store or process personal information outside Quebec, including in the United States [TO CONFIRM: each provider’s storage locations]. Before sending personal information outside Quebec, we assess whether it will be adequately protected, as the law requires.

retention.title: 8. How long we keep it
retention.p1: We keep personal information only as long as we need it for the purposes above, or longer when the law requires it. Billing and accounting records are kept for [TO CONFIRM: retention period for billing records]. Accounts with billing history are deactivated rather than deleted, so that those records stay linked to them. Other information is kept for [TO CONFIRM: retention period for other account data] after an account is closed. When we no longer need personal information, we destroy it or anonymize it.

cookies.title: 9. Cookies
cookies.listIntro: The Platform uses only cookies it needs to work:

items.session: a session cookie from our sign-in system, which keeps you signed in;
items.locale: NEXT_LOCALE and user_preferred_language, which remember your language;
items.stripe: cookies Stripe sets on the payment page to process payments and prevent fraud.

cookies.p1: We do not use advertising or analytics cookies.

security.title: 10. How we protect it
security.p1: We use reasonable security measures suited to the sensitivity of the information, including encrypted connections (HTTPS), sign-in through a dedicated authentication provider, access permissions based on each user’s role, and restricted access to our systems and secrets. No system is perfectly secure.
security.p2: If a confidentiality incident presents a risk of serious injury, we will notify the Commission d’accès à l’information and the people concerned, and we keep a register of confidentiality incidents, as the law requires.

rights.title: 11. Your rights
rights.listIntro: Subject to the law, you have the right to:

items.access: access the personal information we hold about you;
items.correct: have inaccurate, incomplete or outdated information corrected;
items.withdraw: withdraw your consent to a use of your information, which may stop us from providing some services;
items.portability: receive personal information you provided to us in a structured, commonly used technological format;
items.explain: ask how your information is used and who has access to it.

rights.p1: To exercise a right, write to the person in charge of protecting personal information (section 2). We will reply in writing within 30 days. We may need to verify your identity first.

termsPage.title: Terms of Service
termsPage.intro: These Terms of Service (the “Terms”) govern access to and use of Envision Ad (the “Platform”), available at envision-ad.ca. Please read them carefully. By accessing or using the Platform, you agree to these Terms on behalf of your business.

parties.title: 1. Who we are
parties.p1: The Platform is operated by [TO CONFIRM: legal entity name], whose registered office is at [TO CONFIRM: registered address] (“Visual Impact”, “we”, “us” or “our”).
parties.p2: Envision Ad is a marketplace that connects two kinds of businesses: advertisers, who subscribe to bundles of advertising screens to show their ads; and media owners, who list screens they operate and earn a share of what advertisers pay. A business can be both. In these Terms, “you” means the business that holds the account, and each person who uses the Platform on its behalf.
parties.p3: We operate the Platform and collect advertisers’ payments. We do not own or operate the screens: media owners do, and they are responsible for showing ads on them.

accounts.title: 2. Accounts and eligibility
accounts.p1: The Platform is for businesses only. You may use it only on behalf of a business or other organization, and not as a consumer for personal, family or household purposes. By using the Platform, you confirm that you are authorized to bind that business to these Terms.
accounts.p2: There is no public sign-up. Accounts are created by us, or by invitation from an existing member of your organization. Sign-in is handled by our authentication provider, Auth0. We may verify your organization before giving it access to some features.
accounts.p3: You are responsible for keeping your login credentials confidential, for everything done through your organization’s accounts, and for keeping your organization’s information accurate and up to date. When a person leaves your organization, you are responsible for removing their access. Tell us promptly at [TO CONFIRM: contact email] if you believe an account has been used without authorization.

subscriptions.title: 3. Advertiser subscriptions
subscriptions.p1: Advertisers buy advertising through monthly subscriptions to bundles. A bundle is a group of screens defined by city, region, venue type or the full network. To subscribe, you need an ad campaign with at least one ad. That campaign is what media owners show on your subscription’s screens.
subscriptions.p2: The monthly price and the list of screens are fixed when you subscribe and stay the same for the life of that subscription. Screens that join the bundle later are not added to your subscription, and later price changes to the bundle do not affect it.
subscriptions.p3: Your ads are shown in rotation with other ads, according to each screen’s loop duration and operating schedule as listed on the Platform. Media owners choose which ad from your campaign to show on each screen.
subscriptions.p4: If a screen in your subscription becomes unavailable during the subscription: [TO CONFIRM: remedy, for example a credit, a replacement screen, or none].

billing.title: 4. Billing and renewal
billing.p1: Prices are in Canadian dollars (CAD) and are billed monthly in advance. You pay by card through Stripe Checkout, our payment processor. We do not store your full card details. The first month is charged when you subscribe.
billing.p2: Subscriptions renew automatically every month, and your payment method is charged at each renewal until you cancel.
billing.p3: Prices exclude applicable taxes. [TO CONFIRM: how applicable taxes, such as the GST and QST, are charged and shown on invoices].
billing.p4: A discount or promotional code applies only to the subscription it was used for, and only as described when it was offered, including how many months it lasts.
billing.p5: If a renewal payment fails, the subscription becomes past due and the charge is retried [TO CONFIRM: retry schedule]. If payment is still not received, [TO CONFIRM: when the subscription is suspended or cancelled].

cancellation.title: 5. Cancellation and refunds
cancellation.p1: You can cancel a subscription at any time from your Subscriptions page. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period: your ads stay in rotation, and you keep access to the subscription, until then. You will not be charged again.
cancellation.p2: Payments already made are not refunded, including for the rest of a billing period after you cancel. [TO CONFIRM: refund policy, including any exceptions, for example screens that did not show your ad].

mediaOwners.title: 6. Media owner obligations
mediaOwners.p1: When you list a screen, you must describe it accurately and keep its listing up to date, including its location, venue, type of display, size, resolution, loop duration, operating schedule, estimated daily impressions, price and photo. We review new and edited screens before advertisers can buy them, and we may reject a listing.
mediaOwners.p2: When a subscription that includes your screens starts, and when the advertiser changes their ads, we email you the ads to show. You must put them on the subscribed screens within [TO CONFIRM: number of days] and keep them in rotation, as described in the screen’s listing, for as long as the subscription runs.
mediaOwners.p3: If you believe an ad breaks these Terms, the law or your venue’s rules, do not show it, and tell us right away at [TO CONFIRM: contact email].
mediaOwners.p4: Tell us promptly if a screen stops working, is removed, or cannot show ads for more than [TO CONFIRM: duration].
mediaOwners.p5: For a subscription whose screens all belong to you, you must keep a proof-of-display link up to date on the Platform: a page, such as a view-only Canva design, that shows the advertiser’s ads on your screens. We remind you of this every month. We may also ask you for other reasonable proof that ads were shown.
mediaOwners.p6: You must hold every right, permit and permission needed to operate your screens and show ads on them, including the venue’s permission where you do not own the venue.

payouts.title: 7. Revenue share and payouts
payouts.p1: For each subscription invoice that is paid, you receive 70% of the monthly price of your screens in that subscription, as fixed when the advertiser subscribed. We keep the other 30% as our platform fee.
payouts.p2: Discounts and promotional codes we give advertisers come out of our share, not yours: your 70% is calculated on the full price of your screens, as if no discount applied.
payouts.p3: Your share is transferred to your Stripe account after the advertiser’s invoice is paid, [TO CONFIRM: payout timing in days]. Stripe then pays it out to your bank account on your Stripe account’s payout schedule. Nothing is paid for an invoice that has not been paid, such as a failed renewal.
payouts.p4: To receive payouts, you must connect a Stripe account through the Platform and complete Stripe’s onboarding, including identity verification. If your onboarding is not complete when an invoice is paid, your share of that invoice is not transferred automatically. [TO CONFIRM: whether and how such amounts are paid later].
payouts.p5: Payment processing services for media owners on Envision Ad are provided by Stripe and are subject to the Stripe Connected Account Agreement, which includes the Stripe Terms of Service (collectively, the “Stripe Services Agreement”). By agreeing to these Terms or continuing to operate as a media owner on Envision Ad, you agree to be bound by the Stripe Services Agreement, as it may be modified by Stripe from time to time. As a condition of Envision Ad enabling payment processing services through Stripe, you agree to provide us accurate and complete information about you and your business, and you authorize us to share it and transaction information related to your use of the payment processing services provided by Stripe.
payouts.p6: We will give you at least [TO CONFIRM: notice period] notice by email before changing the platform fee.
payouts.p7: If an advertiser’s payment is refunded, reversed or disputed after your share was transferred: [TO CONFIRM: whether we may recover your share, and how].
payouts.p8: You are responsible for your own taxes on amounts you receive. [TO CONFIRM: tax treatment of payouts, including GST and QST].

content.title: 8. Ad content rules
content.p1: You are responsible for your ads. Each ad is an image or a video of up to 30 seconds. Ads are uploaded to and hosted by our media hosting provider, Cloudinary.

termination.title: 11. Suspension and termination
termination.p1: You may stop using the Platform at any time. To close your organization’s account, contact us at [TO CONFIRM: contact email]. Cancel your subscriptions first: closing an account does not undo payments already made.
termination.p2: We may suspend or deactivate an account, cancel subscriptions or remove listings if you breach these Terms, if the law requires it, or to protect the Platform, its users or the public. Where reasonable, we will tell you beforehand and give you a chance to fix the problem.
termination.p3: Accounts with billing history are deactivated rather than deleted, and we keep billing records for as long as the law requires.
termination.p4: Sections that by their nature should continue after termination remain in effect, including payment obligations, the licences needed to keep records, disclaimers, limitation of liability, indemnity and governing law.
